Dear [Miss Higginbotham](../persons.html#693)
I think you will find the beginning of the stories in the [Castle builders](../books.html#18) & [Countess Kate](../books.html#44), which are in the hands of [Innes](../persons.html#744), 31 Bedford Street Covent Garden.[^1]

Yours truly

C M Yonge

[^1]: The question was evidently which were the earliest of the linked stories.

Innes reprinted Countess Kate in 1892 and The Castle-Builders in 1896.
